components.name: Power (grid_status of the next phase)
components.rule: energized 1.0 · interconnect agreement signed 0.75 · hybrid grid + on-site 0.7 · behind-the-meter generation 0.6 · in interconnection queue 0.3 · unknown 0.2

components.name: Build progress
components.rule: next phase complete/commissioning 1.0 · an earlier phase operating and the next under construction (dated evidence) 0.8 · under construction, evidence within 120 days 0.6 · construction evidence older than 120 days 0.4 · announced only 0.2

components.name: Hardware
components.rule: accelerators installed in the next phase 1.0 · installed in an earlier phase, or delivery disclosed 0.6 · not disclosed 0.3

components.name: Operator track record
components.rule: prior sites delivered on time (evidence) 1.0 · mixed or limited history 0.6 · no history 0.5 · documented slips 0.3

components.name: Delay penalty
components.rule: −0.10 per distinct, sourced delay signal in the last 12 months (slipped date, permit fight, financing or equipment trouble), capped at −0.30

rubric.probability_map: P(on time) = 0.10 + 0.80 × S; P(within 6 months of target) = P + (1 − P) × (0.3 + 0.4 × S), capped at 0.97 — a weak site is less likely to recover a slip quickly. Rounded to whole percentage points.
